label: Много
description: A 10-sentence usage card for много (much; many; a lot).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Quantity with genitive. 'Много' takes the genitive complement 'работы' to mean a large amount of work. This is the core pattern: 'много' plus a genitive noun expresses abundance.
Strategic focus: Modifying a verb. Here 'много' attaches directly to the verb 'работает' to mean he works a great deal. With verbs it needs no genitive noun and is often intensified by 'очень'.
Strategic focus: Counting people. 'Много' governs the genitive plural 'людей' to state that there are many people. The pattern 'много' plus genitive plural is standard for countable nouns.
Strategic focus: Object quantity in genitive. 'Много книг' is the object of 'читаю', with 'книг' in the genitive plural after 'много'. It shows large quantity rather than a definite number.

Strategic focus: Quantity in the past. 'Много времени' uses the genitive singular 'времени' to mean plenty of time. The neuter past 'было' agrees with the quantity expression, which behaves as neuter.
Strategic focus: Frequency through quantity. 'Много' modifies 'путешествует' to mean she travels a lot. With a verb it conveys high frequency or extent without any genitive complement.

Strategic focus: Genitive of an uncountable. 'Много' takes the genitive 'вкусной еды' to describe a lot of tasty food. With mass nouns it pairs with the genitive singular, including any agreeing adjective.
Strategic focus: Verb modification in the past. 'Много' attaches to 'говорили' to mean we talked a great deal yesterday. Placed before the verb, it measures the extent of the action.

missions.phrase: У него много друзей в школе.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Possession of many. 'Много друзей' uses the genitive plural 'друзей' in a possession frame with 'у него'. It states that he has a large number of friends.
Strategic focus: Standalone excess. 'Много' stands alone as a predicate meaning 'a lot', intensified by 'слишком' to mean too much. No genitive noun is needed when the amount is clear from context.
